answers.core: Most 3D projects with diegetic UI and XR projects will need this at some point to ensure their UI looks good, particularly at lower viewport resolutions (e.g. on Steam Deck).
answers.workaround: For materials applied on MeshInstance3D, this can be worked around with a custom shader. However, for Label3D or Sprite3D, this can't be done without a lot of additional work to use the material override.

title: Add an option to use texture supersampling in BaseMaterial3D
